summary: Dependency sourced from an unpinned GitHub ref executes arbitrary code at install
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as a direct dependency with the value `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub reference with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. `npm install` resolves this to whatever the current state of that repository is at install time and runs any lifecycle scripts it ships. Whoever controls `wanzchil/libsignal-node` (now or in the future, including after a repo transfer or account compromise) can push arbitrary code that executes on every installer's machine, bypassing the npm registry's artifact and version controls. The yara `ping`/`GET` match on `lib/Utils/generics.js` corresponds to generic WhatsApp protocol handling (keep-alive ping and HTTP GET to media endpoints) and is not itself an installer-side harm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
